meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 它会把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/，注册并安装固定版本依赖、给 matrix-js-sdk 打 ESM 补丁，再构建并跑注册测试，让 NanoClaw 支持收发 Matrix 消息。
howto.when: 当你需要给 NanoClaw 项目添加 Matrix 通道支持，或要为独立的 Matrix 机器人账号配置登录凭据时，它会接管这些步骤。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 Matrix 通道支持
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并构建

say.text: 用 matrix.org 家居服务器配置 Matrix 机器人凭据
say.note: 把 MATRIX_* 变量写入环境

say.text: 跑一下 Matrix 注册测试，确认适配器装好了
say.note: 导入真实 barrel，断言注册表含 matrix

howto.what_en: It copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then builds and runs the registration test so NanoClaw supports Matrix messaging.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to add Matrix channel support to a NanoClaw project, or need to configure login credentials for a separate Matrix bot account.

say_en.text: Add Matrix channel support to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds

say_en.text: Configure Matrix bot credentials for matrix.org
Run the Matrix registration test to check the adapter
say_en.note: Imports the real barrel, asserts matrix
